intro: One piece of ayam percik is about 350 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the chicken with skin and the santan-based percik sauce.

breakdown.part: Sugar and spices in the sauce

diet: Yes. Ayam percik is grilled, so it's lighter than fried chicken. The santan sauce is what adds calories, so don't ask for extra. One piece with half a plate of rice and ulam is still okay for weight loss.
tips: Ask for a thin brush of percik sauce, not a pour-over.
Remove the skin to save about 60-80 kcal.
Pair it with ulam or kerabu, not nasi kerabu with lots of kelapa.

swap.name: Plain ayam bakar (thigh)
swap.why: Still grilled and high in protein, without the heavy santan sauce.

faq.q: Which state is ayam percik from?
faq.a: Ayam percik is famous in Kelantan and Terengganu. Now it's easy to find at Ramadan bazaars all over Malaysia.

faq.q: What's the difference between ayam percik and ayam bakar?
faq.a: Ayam percik is brushed with spiced santan sauce while grilling. Normal ayam bakar uses a soy sauce, honey or turmeric marinade.

faq.q: Can I make ayam percik in the oven?
faq.a: Yes. Bake the chicken in the oven and brush on the percik sauce a few times until slightly charred at the edges.
